title: Green Rewards Card: Which Merchants Are Considered Sustainable?
summary: Explains how Green Rewards Card merchant eligibility is determined using merchant classification, environmental certifications, and program criteria. Lists eligible merchant types (e.g., renewable energy, public transit, EV charging, green hotels, recycling) and non-qualifying cases (general retailers without sustainable classification, unverified marketplace end merchant categories, cash equivalents/funding), and notes qualifying purchases earn 3.0% cash back.
faqs: Which merchant types qualify as “sustainable” for the Green Rewards Card?
What kinds of merchants do not qualify or may be mixed-category?
How can I verify whether a merchant on my transaction is eligible?
Do marketplace transactions qualify if the end merchant category can’t be verified?
Are cash equivalents or funding transactions eligible for Green Rewards cash back?
When purchases are from qualifying sustainable merchants, what rewards rate applies?
